- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the Mahabharata, Sage Durvasa curses King Ambarisha, leading to the Sudarshana Chakra protecting him.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sudarshana Chakra appears in the story of Samudra Manthan to help the Devas and Asuras churn the ocean.
- [USER] User asked for more information about the Sudarshana Chakra's abilities and powers in Hindu mythology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sudarshana Chakra is known for its precision, speed, volatility, protection, cleansing, and divine nature.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sudarshana Chakra can hit any target with great accuracy, travel at the speed of light, and destroy anything in its path.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It creates a protective shield around its wielder and purifies anything it touches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sudarshana Chakra is considered invincible and capable of overcoming any obstacle or enemy.
